The Bitcoin Demand Index tracks the conviction of meaningful BTC holders — long-term on-chain holders, ETF flows, and corporate treasuries — then translates that composite into a simple posture signal inside the broader Milk Road On-chain Dashboard. Stay long while the demand index is above zero; move to cash when it drops below −0.3; hold your current position in between.

This week’s read · Bitcoin Demand Index · 2026-10-11

The dashboard holds CASH with zero BTC exposure. The Bitcoin Demand Index sits at −0.14, squarely inside the hold band: above the −0.30 exit floor but still short of the 0.00 entry threshold needed to flip LONG, so the prior CASH posture carries forward unchanged. The seven-day drift of +0.25 is the only encouraging number — on-chain holders are modestly constructive at +0.15 and spot ETF flows add +0.32, but Corporate treasury accumulation is deeply negative at −0.87 and is single-handedly keeping the composite below zero. A sustained continuation of the current trend, specifically a move in the Bitcoin Demand Index through 0.00 on a closing basis, is the only thing that would trigger re-entry to LONG; a reversal back below −0.30 would instead confirm the exit and lock in CASH with no ambiguity.
